title: High-hazard Group H-3.
officialText: Buildings and structures containing materials that readily support combustion or present a physical hazard shall be classified as Group H-3. Such materials shall include, but not be limited to, the following: Class I, II or IIIA flammable or combustible liquids which are used or stored in normally closed containers or systems pressurized at less than 15 psi (103 kPa) gage. Combustible fibers Cryogenic fluids, oxidizing Flammable solids Organic peroxides, Classes II and III Oxidizers, Classes 1 and 2 Oxidizing gases Unstable (reactive) materials, Class 2 Water-reactive materials, Class 2, nondetonable
